description: CSV time series accompany three water-quality case studies in the Gleeson research. They support investigation of sensor fusion for drinking-water quality management. This resource is provided by Killian Gleeson. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, TXT formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Case study 3 has documented data-quality problems and unusual patterns after operational activity. Case study 4 is withheld under a water-company NDA. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
